summary: The agent clarified several important modeling details, including exact demand satisfaction and contract start timing, but stopped before confirming the optimization objective and missed key business constraints on contract-length diversity and distinct-contract limits.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
